primitive: REG_OLS penalty l2 / l1 / elasticnet: glmnet's standardize = FALSE objective, intercept unpenalised
r_function: s * coef(glmnet(x, y / s, gaussian, weights, alpha = alpha', lambda = lambda', standardize = FALSE, control = list(thresh = 1e-24, maxit = 1e8)))
note: Pulse alpha / l1_ratio map to glmnet lambda' / alpha' on the unit-SD response y/s (s the weighted population SD): lambda' = alpha*(1 - r) + alpha*r/s, alpha' = (alpha*r/s)/lambda'. rows are [predictors..., y, w]; N* = sum(w). Every case is self-checked against the KKT conditions of the stated objective at relative 1e-10. l2 cases add std_errors / p_values / df: the closed-form ridge covariance sigma2 * A^-1 G A^-1 (A = G + N* alpha I, G the weighted centred Gram, sigma2 = RSS/(N* - p - 1)), Var(b0) = sigma2/N* + mu' V mu, Student-t p on N* - p - 1 df, computed by R matrix algebra (ridge_inference). l1 / elasticnet cases carry no inference: their standard errors and p-values are undefined (null in Pulse). leverage (every case) is the penalised hat diag(W^1/2 Xa (Xa' W Xa + N* lambda2 diag(0, pf_A))^-1 Xa' W^1/2), Xa = [1, X_A]: l2 A = all, lambda2 = alpha; l1 A = active set, lambda2 = 0; elasticnet A = active set, lambda2 = alpha*(1 - l1_ratio) (penalized_hat); l1 / elasticnet cases add df_glmnet, glmnet's df, asserted equal to |active|. A case listing unpenalized (any penalty kind) fits glmnet with penalty.factor 0 on those predictors and lambda' * sum(pf) / nvars (undoing glmnet's penalty.factor rescaling); an l2 case's ridge covariance uses A = G + N* alpha diag(pf).
